args.root_cause:
Player TNT_Tommy joined at 07:13:24, was switched to Creative mode and teleported to x=17.5, z=11.5 via RCON (source of that RCON command unknown), and then systematically broke 35 blocks in a grid at x=14, z=8-14, y=-60 to -56 (oak_planks, plus 3 glass_pane at y=-58, z=10-12), per plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv. Breaking stopped at 07:14:06 local. Mira_Crafts was also in Creative and placed cobblestone at x=-22..-17, z=20-21 during the same window; I did not determine whether that was griefing. I could not read protected.json (single 80 KB line) so I did not confirm whether the x=14 area was a protected or owned region.</root_cause>
<parameter name="actions">Checked status, server log, and plugin data (BlockLog blocks.csv, AuditTrail config). Declared incident. Attempted to read protected.json (too large to read; not resolved). Set TNT_Tommy to Spectator via console ("gamemode spectator TNT_Tommy") to stop further block breaking, without banning or kicking. Restored all 35 blocks broken by TNT_Tommy at x=14, z=8-14, y=-60..-56 using console setblock with the BlockLog 'before' values (oak_planks, or glass_pane at y=-58 z=10-12). Monitored status and BlockLog for about 2 minutes after containment; no new break entries and no further player-caused block changes were logged. Did not restart the server. Did not ban anyone. Did not modify any files on disk.</actions>
<parameter name="resolved">false
args.residual_risk: Incident is contained but not fully resolved. TNT_Tommy remains online in Spectator mode and must be reviewed by staff; the RCON command that set TNT_Tommy and Mira_Crafts to Creative and teleported them is unexplained (could be staff action or abuse) and needs checking. Ownership and protection status of the x=14 wall is unverified; if the wall belonged to another player, the owner should confirm the restoration is correct. The setblock restores are not recorded in BlockLog, so the audit trail shows the breaks but not the repairs. Mira_Crafts is still in Creative and her cobblestone placements at x=-22..-17, z=20-21 were not reviewed. Heap fluctuated between about 330 and 470 MB during the shift, consistent with normal GC; no leak was seen. I was unable to read protected.json.
